items.title: The Phoenix Suns plan to waive two-way guard Koby Brea, league sources told HoopsHype. Brea shot 43.3% from 3-point range in 12 games with the Suns last season. With center Mark Williams injured to start the season, Phoenix will look to add frontcourt depth on the two-way market.
